segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner controls T-zone oiliness and removes residual oil, and one with oily skin plus fine lines found it softening and gentle.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it moisturizes and soothes without drying, though one with sensitive/oily skin developed bumps and another found it drying and irritating.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report visible improvement in forehead texture and control of oily T-zones alongside fading spots.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it does not irritate, sting, or break them out, while others with sensitive or sensitive-oily skin report bumps, cystic breakouts, burning, or a reaction after repurchase.
segments.mature: One reviewer using it alongside other Murad products reports fading dark spots and more even pigment over two months.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for age spots and fine lines report fading dark spots, brighter under-eye area, and more even pigment; effects are described as gradual over two weeks to two months.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates, soothes, and does not leave skin dry, but one reviewer reports it dried out and irritated her skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer states explicitly it did not help her redness or broken capillaries despite being recommended for that.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as balancing, non-irritating, and prepping skin well for moisturizer, with a few exceptions of stinging or burning on reapplication.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading dark spots, more even skin tone, and improved post-acne marks over one to two weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several say breakouts improved or cleared, including one describing resolution of months-long cystic acne, while others report new bumps, cystic pimples, or milia starting after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report it removes excess oil and controls oily T-zones without feeling heavy.

extraits.texte: I wanted to love this product since I also have the dark circle corrector and vitamin C brightening serum which have worked beautifully for my skin but once I started using this toner I began to get little bumps all over my cheeks and forehead. After a couple of days I stopped using this toner and bought a different one and my skin started to clear up. I do have somewhat sensitive and oily skin, so I would just be careful with this one for those with sensitive skin!

Product was easy to apply and used for almost a month and I kept noticing new acne bumps and didn't think it was this product, however, I now realize it is and my acne is out of control and in places that I never got acne before. Should've stopped using it as soon as I noticing the tiny white heads.

I'm not blown away by this toner. I got it because it's alcohol-free, but the spray top is really annoying. I usually put toners on a cotton ball, which is better for wiping away impurities, and this just kind of sits on the skin. Either that, or I spray it onto a cotton ball, and it wastes some of the product. I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin, and this toner doesn't make me break out. My breakouts have actually been improving since using this toner, but I'm also using a bunch of other new products, so I can't really tell if this is what's doing it. It definitely balances skin better than no toner though, and I like that it has Vitamin C in it, since I need many products to help fade my post-acne marks and am conscious of environmental/sun damage. I think after I finish the bottle, I'm going to go looking for a new toner, preferably something that is alcohol-free and has Vitamin C in it. I'm still deciding for sure though.

extraits.titre: Definitely going to buy again and again
extraits.texte: I've been using this for two weeks now and this stuff is amazing. I was dealing with major cystic acne for 6 months. I'm 29 and never had it before! I even tried curology and was prescribed prescription antibiotics and ointments by my actual doctor. Both still didn't help me at all. Not sure what was causing it, all I know is I changed up my skincare routine with this and it's been amazing. I had acne along my jaw bone and sides of my cheeks. I still have some scaring now, but this has totally been clearing up breakouts! I no longer have painful acne. Even after I wash my face and shower, then use it with a cotton pad there is dirt that comes off so it really helps clear out pores. I spray it on my face and then wipe with the cotton pad. My skin is also glowing! The acne had caused it to have horrible texture and uneven skin tone, but this has made it much softer too. I love it and will definitely keep buying this!

I have combination skin, and have been struggling with a lot of texture on my forehead. I've used this morning and night for about two weeks and have seen SOOOO much improvement in the texture it's unreal!!! I do use about 4-5 sprays directly on my face, rub it in after a few seconds, and follow up with a light moisturizer. Please don't ever stop making this!!

Even though it is little pricy I kept getting this toner. This is perfect for my skin not too dry yet leaves me refreshing tightening results. It works for me as it gradually dimishes my spots and controls oily T-zones in combination skin.

This item has a nice refreshing smell that disappears after it dries. I have oily skin with a few fines lines and uneven skin tone. I was not sure if I should try this product or the clarfying toner but I am glad I picked this one. It has made my skin softer, I also feel this product is gentle but effective.
